analysis:
Every unit in this batch is under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests, so none of it ships in the provider binary. The PR adds no runtime attack surface.

NemotronSuperLocalOutputTests.swift (lines 239-254): the plan test now expects a JSON response_format together with tools to be accepted (previously refused). The behavior change itself lives in non-test source I did not see. The new tests (OpenRouterCapabilityTests lines 114-133) assert that fail-closed behavior is kept: prose is rejected under json_object plus tools, and tool_choice=required without a call throws. This is consistent with the T-008/T-010 fail-closed posture. The production change for response_format plus tools needs a source-level check that forced tool_choice still rejects visible text.

NemotronSuperMediaChargeTests.swift: the over-limit error expectation changes from invalidInput to bodyTooLarge. A new test (lines 59-74) asserts that a body holding one part at MediaIngest.maxMediaDecodedBytes fits Policy.maximumEncodedBodyBytes, and that localInferenceMaxUploadBytes and CoordinatorClient.maxInboundMessageBytes stay within it. The media charge rises, from 3,888,385,020 to 5,012,458,492 for one image and from 26,317,356,540 to 27,441,430,012 for sixteen, so admission becomes more conservative (a DoS-safe direction, T-010). The actual constants and bounds are in unseen non-test source; whether the body ceiling was raised and whether the memory reservation covers it should be reviewed there.

OpenRouterCapabilityShapes.swift and OpenRouterCapabilityTests.swift: synthetic fixture bodies with no secrets or endpoints. The tests use trustsSchemaMetadata: true to mirror the coordinator path. The existing test at LocalOutputTests lines 259-290 confirms that forged reserved schema metadata from a local client is rejected.

NemotronSuperServingPolicyTests.swift (0 hunks visible, metadata only): the prefix-bank size expectations change (the 34 GiB grant gives 10<<28, and the 45 GiB grant gives 32<<28). That is a smaller RAM carve tied to the media charge; it is not an at-rest cache change and does not affect T-041.

I found no regression. needs_deeper_review is true only because the paired production source (request plan, ingress bounds, policy constants) was not supplied.
